name: academic-writer
description: AI-first academic writing assistant for Humanities researchers. Produces rigorously cited, style-matched academic articles as .docx files.

google_api_key.title: Gemini API key
google_api_key.description: Your free Google Gemini API key, used by the plugin's drafting, evidence, proofreading and OCR steps. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey; /academic-writer:setup walks you through it. Kept in your operating system's keychain, never in a plain settings file. Takes effect in a new Claude Code session. Leave empty if you set GOOGLE_API_KEY in your environment instead.

jev_api_key.title: Jev (TypeSafe) API key
jev_api_key.description: Advanced and optional: most users should leave this empty. A Jev (TypeSafe) API key for experimental decision-scoring. In this version every Jev point runs in shadow mode: its answers are only logged and never change your results, but when a key is set the question and context at those points are also sent to the Jev service. Kept in your operating system's keychain.

pageindex_command.title: PageIndex library command (optional)
pageindex_command.description: Only if you use a PageIndex library on your own server as a second place to read your books from. Type the command that starts it, for example: pilib. If a helper script reaches your server for you, type that script's full path, for example: /path/to/pilib-wrapper. Leave empty to use the built-in PageIndex helper if you installed it (setup offers it), or Trove only. A command typed here always wins over the built-in helper. Avoid quotation marks in this setting. Not a password: it holds no secret, so do not put a key or password here. Takes effect in a new Claude Code session.

activity_pane.title: Live activity pane
activity_pane.description: Show a live pane in Claude Code that follows each article run step by step: which step is running, which sections are drafted, and what the checker rejected and why. It only reads the run's record and never changes anything. Needs a terminal at least 144 columns wide to open by itself; /academic-writer:watch opens it on request. Takes effect in a new Claude Code session.
